sets.relationshipLabel: a worker and the tool of their trade
sets.explanation: A teacher wields a chalkboard and a coach wields a whistle, so each professional pairs with the instrument that defines their role.

sets.relationshipLabel: raw work transformed through effort into a finished form
sets.explanation: Lecture notes become a study guide and a rough draft becomes a polished essay, each pair showing raw material refined by deliberate effort into a finished product.

sets.relationshipLabel: a signal and the event it announces
sets.explanation: A fire alarm necessarily triggers an evacuation and a tornado siren necessarily triggers a shelter drill, so each signal is bound to the response it mandates.

sets.relationshipLabel: the start and end of a bounded span
sets.explanation: Homeroom opens a school day just as kindergarten opens a schooling career, and dismissal and graduation close each span, so the pairs share the same start-and-end shape at very different scales.
